description: Hand-authored pairs for a judge position-bias test: each pair has a prompt and two candidate responses of genuinely different quality, written so which one is better is unambiguous. Used by scripts/run_position_bias_test.py to check whether the judge's verdict changes when the two responses are presented in the opposite order.

pairs.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
pairs.response_better: The capital of Australia is Canberra, not Sydney as many assume.
pairs.response_worse: The capital of Australia is Sydney.

pairs.prompt: How do I reset a forgotten password on your platform?
pairs.response_better: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your email, and follow the reset link sent to your inbox (valid for 30 minutes).
pairs.response_worse: You cannot reset your password once forgotten; you must create a new account.

pairs.prompt: What is the time complexity of quicksort in the average case?
pairs.response_better: Quicksort has an average-case time complexity of O(n log n), though its worst case is O(n^2) on already-sorted or adversarial input.
pairs.response_worse: Quicksort always runs in O(n) time.

pairs.prompt: What causes rainbows to appear in the sky?
pairs.response_better: Rainbows form when sunlight is refracted, reflected, and dispersed by water droplets in the air, splitting light into its component colors.
pairs.response_worse: Rainbows appear because the sky reflects colored light from clouds.

pairs.prompt: What is the difference between TCP and UDP?
pairs.response_better: TCP is connection-oriented and guarantees ordered, reliable delivery with retransmission; UDP is connectionless and faster but doesn't guarantee delivery or order.
pairs.response_worse: TCP and UDP are basically the same thing, just different names for sending data over a network.

pairs.prompt: How do I cancel a recurring subscription on your platform?
pairs.response_better: Go to Account Settings > Subscription and click Cancel. You'll keep access until the current billing period ends, with no further charges.
pairs.response_worse: Subscriptions cannot be canceled once started; you'll need to contact your bank to block the charge.

pairs.prompt: What is the boiling point of water at sea level in Fahrenheit?
pairs.response_better: Water boils at 212 degrees Fahrenheit at sea level.
pairs.response_worse: Water boils at 100 degrees Fahrenheit at sea level.

pairs.prompt: What does the term 'idempotent' mean for an HTTP method?
pairs.response_better: An idempotent method produces the same result no matter how many times the same request is repeated, like PUT or DELETE.
pairs.response_worse: Idempotent means the request is encrypted for security.

pairs.prompt: Who is credited with developing the theory of general relativity?
pairs.response_better: Albert Einstein developed the theory of general relativity, published in 1915.
pairs.response_worse: Isaac Newton developed the theory of general relativity.

pairs.prompt: What is a primary key in a relational database?
pairs.response_better: A primary key is a column (or set of columns) that uniquely identifies each row in a table and cannot contain NULL values.
pairs.response_worse: A primary key is just any column you decide to search by most often.

pairs.prompt: How long does standard domestic shipping usually take?
pairs.response_better: Standard domestic shipping typically takes 3-5 business days from the time the order ships.
pairs.response_worse: Standard domestic shipping is instant and arrives the same day every time.

pairs.prompt: What is the purpose of a firewall in network security?
pairs.response_better: A firewall monitors and filters incoming and outgoing network traffic based on defined security rules, blocking unauthorized access.
pairs.response_worse: A firewall makes your internet connection faster by compressing data.

pairs.prompt: What year did the Berlin Wall fall?
pairs.response_better: The Berlin Wall fell in 1989, leading to German reunification in 1990.

pairs.prompt: What is the difference between a list and a tuple in Python?
pairs.response_better: Lists are mutable (can be changed after creation) while tuples are immutable; tuples are generally faster and used for fixed collections of items.
pairs.response_worse: Lists and tuples are exactly the same in Python, just written with different brackets.

pairs.response_better: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide into glucose and oxygen, mainly in chloroplasts.
pairs.response_worse: Photosynthesis is how animals digest sunlight for energy.
